### Network, Community of Practice, and Group Sizes {#com-met}

Membership counts are organized as follows: Groups are listed under their parent Network or Communities of Practice (CoP). CoPs that belong to Networks are shown separately and not counted in the Network total. Group members are included in their parent Network or CoP count.

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false

# Function to create hierarchical dataframe with Display_Name
create_hierarchical_df <- function(parent_df, child_df, parent_type) {
  parent_df_display <- parent_df %>%
    left_join(
      community_tags %>% select(Tags, Display_Name),
      by = "Tags"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Display_Name = if_else(is.na(Display_Name) | Display_Name == "", Name, Display_Name))
  
  child_df_display <- child_df %>%
    left_join(
      community_tags %>% select(Tags, Display_Name),
      by = "Tags"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Display_Name = if_else(is.na(Display_Name) | Display_Name == "", Name, Display_Name))
  
  parent_child_pairs <- parent_df_display %>%
    select(Tags, Display_Name, Members, Privacy) %>%
    mutate(Type = parent_type) %>%
    left_join(
      child_df_display %>%  
        filter(!is.na(Parent_Tag) & Parent_Tag != "") %>%
        select(Parent_Tag, Display_Name, Members, Privacy),
      by = c("Tags" = "Parent_Tag"),
      relationship = "one-to-many"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      row_id = row_number(),
      has_children = !is.na(Display_Name.y)
    )
  
  result <- bind_rows(
    # Parent rows
    parent_child_pairs %>%
      distinct(Tags, Display_Name.x, Members.x, Privacy.x, Type) %>%
      transmute(
        Display_Name = Display_Name.x,
        Members = Members.x,
        Privacy = Privacy.x,
        Parent_Tag = Tags,
        Sort_Order = Members.x,
        Is_Parent = TRUE
      ),
    # Child rows
    parent_child_pairs %>%
      filter(has_children) %>%
      transmute(
        Display_Name = paste0("&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style='color: #666;'>↳</span> ", Display_Name.y),
        Members = Members.y,
        Privacy = Privacy.y,
        Parent_Tag = Tags,
        Sort_Order = Members.x,
        Is_Parent = FALSE
      )
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Sort_Order), desc(Is_Parent), desc(Members))
  
  return(result)
}

# Create hierarchical dataframes
network_hierarchical <- create_hierarchical_df(df_network, df_group, "Network")
cop_hierarchical <- create_hierarchical_df(df_cop, df_group, "CoP")

# Combine based on max members
max_network_size <- max(df_network$Members, na.rm = TRUE)
max_cop_size <- max(df_cop$Members, na.rm = TRUE)

hierarchical_table <- if (max_network_size >= max_cop_size) {
  bind_rows(network_hierarchical, cop_hierarchical)
} else {
  bind_rows(cop_hierarchical, network_hierarchical)
}

# Identify parent rows
parent_rows <- which(hierarchical_table$Is_Parent)

# Add subtle Privacy badges
hierarchical_table <- hierarchical_table %>%
  mutate(
    Privacy = case_when(
      Privacy == "Open" ~ "<span style='background-color: #eaf7ec; color: #2c7a2c; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 12px; display: inline-block; text-align: center;'>Open</span>",
      Privacy == "Closed" ~ "<span style='background-color: #faeaea; color: #a33a3a; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 12px; display: inline-block; text-align: center;'>Closed</span>",
      TRUE ~ Privacy
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Display_Name, Members, Privacy, Is_Parent)

# Column padding value (matches child indentation)
column_padding <- "15px"

# Build the table
kbl(
  hierarchical_table %>% select(-Is_Parent),
  format = "html",
  align = c("l", "r", "r"),  # first column left, others right
  escape = FALSE,
  col.names = c("Community", "Members", "Privacy")
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    font_size = 15,
    position = "center",
    fixed_thead = TRUE
  ) %>%
  # First column: add left padding to align header with data
  column_spec(1, width = "35em", extra_css = paste0("padding-left: ", column_padding, ";")) %>%
  # Second and third columns: right-aligned, header aligned with padding
  column_spec(2, width = "10em", extra_css = paste0("text-align: left; padding-right: ", column_padding, ";")) %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "10em", extra_css = paste0("text-align: right; ", column_padding, "; font-weight: normal !important;")) %>%
  # Header row styling (apply same left padding to first column)
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#009ADE", extra_css = paste0("text-align: center; padding-left: ", column_padding, ";")) %>%
  # Parent rows bold for Community + Members, light background
  row_spec(parent_rows, background = "#f8f9fa", extra_css = "font-weight: bold;") %>%
  # Child rows not bold
  row_spec(setdiff(seq_len(nrow(hierarchical_table)), parent_rows), bold = FALSE)



```

### Engagement in the Largest Communities of Practice

The table below summarizes activity in the five largest Collaboratory communities of practice, including participation and engagement within their subgroups.

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false


# Create the data frame with proper column names and prevent automatic renaming
community_table <- data.frame(
  "Community" = c("Mpox Analytics", 
                  "IPSN Wastewater and Environmental Surveillance",
                   "Epidemiological Parameters", 
                   "Influenza Epidemiology and Advanced Analytics",
                  "Epidemiological Pipelines"),
  
  "Users" = c(124, 121, 111, 98, 79),
  "Topics" = c(41, 7, 49, 33, 6),
  "Posts" = c(141, 78, 158, 59, 23),
  "Likes" = c(173, 182, 133, 33, 44),

)

# Format the table to match the styling of metrics_table
community_table %>%
  kbl(
    format = "html",
    align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling( 
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
    full_width = FALSE,

  column_spec(3, width = "8em") %>%                # Topics
  column_spec(4, width = "8em") %>%                # Posts
  column_spec(5, width = "8em") %>%                # Likes
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#009ADE")  # Consistent header

```

### Cross-Community Connectivity {#cross-com}

The following table reflects membership in CoPs only and does not include Networks:

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
#| include: false

# Get all users first
all_users <- data1 %>%
  filter(!(email %in% c("discobot_email", "no_email"))) %>%
  mutate(UserID = row_number()) %>%
  select(UserID, email)

# Calculate cross-community connectivity for CoPs only
user_cop_memberships <- data1 %>%
  filter(!(email %in% c("discobot_email", "no_email"))) %>%
  mutate(UserID = row_number()) %>%
  separate_rows(group_names, sep = ";") %>%
  filter(group_names != "", group_names %in% df_cop$Tags) %>%
  select(UserID, email, group_names)

# Count number of CoPs per user (including 0 for users not in any CoP)
user_cop_counts <- user_cop_memberships %>%
  group_by(UserID, email) %>%
  summarise(num_cops = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Add users with 0 CoP memberships
all_users_with_counts <- all_users %>%
  left_join(user_cop_counts, by = c("UserID", "email")) %>%
  mutate(num_cops = replace_na(num_cops, 0))

# Create connectivity summary with proper ordering
connectivity_summary <- all_users_with_counts %>%
  mutate(
    membership_category = case_when(
      num_cops == 0 ~ "None",
      num_cops == 1 ~ "1 CoP",
      num_cops == 2 ~ "2 CoPs",
      num_cops == 3 ~ "3 CoPs",
      num_cops >= 4 ~ "4+ CoPs"
    ),
    order = case_when(
      num_cops == 0 ~ 1,
      num_cops == 1 ~ 2,
      num_cops == 2 ~ 3,
      num_cops == 3 ~ 4,
      num_cops >= 4 ~ 5
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(membership_category, order) %>%
  summarise(
    `Number of Users` = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(order) %>%
  mutate(
    `Percentage of Total Users` = paste0(round(100 * `Number of Users` / sum(`Number of Users`), 1), "%")
  ) %>%
  select(
    `Membership` = membership_category,
    `Number of Users`,
    `Percentage of Total Users`
  )

```

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false

# Display cross-community connectivity table
connectivity_summary %>%
  kbl(
    format = "html",
    align = c("l", "r", "r"),
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    font_size = 15,
    position = "center"
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "25em") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "10em") %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "25em") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#009ADE")
```

### Cross-Community Map

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)

# ---- Prepare and filter user data ----
data1_groups <- data1 %>%
  filter(!(email %in% c("discobot_email", "no_email"))) %>%
  mutate(id = row_number()) %>%               # create unique ID
  select(id, group_names) %>%
  separate_rows(group_names, sep = ";") %>%
  filter(group_names %in% df_cop$Tags) %>%   # only keep CoP tags
  distinct(id, group_names)

# ---- Compute shared membership edges ----
group_pairs <- data1_groups %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(
    group_pairings = if(length(unique(group_names)) >= 2) {
      list(combn(sort(unique(group_names)), 2, simplify = FALSE))
    } else {
      list(NULL)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest(group_pairings) %>%
  filter(!is.null(group_pairings)) %>%
  mutate(
    from = map_chr(group_pairings, 1),
    to = map_chr(group_pairings, 2)
  ) %>%
  count(from, to, name = "shared_members")

# ---- Compute node sizes ----
node_sizes <- df_cop %>%
  select(Tags, Members) %>%
  rename(name = Tags, member_count = Members)

# ---- Build graph ----
community_graph <- tbl_graph(edges = group_pairs, directed = FALSE) %>%
  activate(nodes) %>%
  left_join(node_sizes, by = "name") %>%  # bring in member counts
  left_join(community_tags %>% select(Tags, Display_Name), by = c("name" = "Tags")) %>%  # bring in Display_Name from community_tags
  mutate(
    member_count = replace_na(member_count, 1),
    display_name = if_else(is.na(Display_Name) | Display_Name == "", name, Display_Name)  # fallback to tag if Display_Name missing
  )


```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 12
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
ggraph(community_graph, layout = "fr", niter = 3000, area = vcount(community_graph)^2 * 10) + 
  geom_edge_link(aes(edge_width = shared_members), alpha = 0.4, color = "#009ADE") + 
  geom_node_point(aes(size = sqrt(member_count)), alpha = 0.9, color = "#F4A81D") + 
  geom_node_text(aes(label = display_name), repel = TRUE, size = 4, force = 10, color = "#00205C", fontface = "bold") + 
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 12), name = "Group Size") + 
  scale_edge_width_continuous(range = c(0.5, 3), name = "Shared Members") + 
  theme_void() + 
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 80, 20),   # extra space for stacked legends
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.box = "vertical",                # stacks the two legends nicely
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, family = "Lato", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, face = "italic", family = "Lato", color = "#00205C")
  )

```
